# MO Behavior Therapy

> MO Behavior Therapy LLC provides individualized, BCBA-led Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy for children, delivered at home, at school, and in the community across Florida's Treasure Coast and surrounding counties.

## Company
- Legal name: MO Behavior Therapy LLC
- NPI: 1457196420
- Phone: (305) 795-0600
- Email: mobehavior@mobehaviortherapy.com
- Office: 130 S Indian River Dr, Suite 237, Fort Pierce, FL 34950
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:30 AM-5:00 PM
- Lead clinician: Mauricio Garcia Losada, M.S., BCBA (Lead Analyst)
- Website: https://mobehaviortherapy.com
- Languages supported on the site: English, Spanish (Espanol), Haitian Creole (Kreyol Ayisyen), Portuguese (Portugues), French (Francais), German (Deutsch)

## Service Areas
MO Behavior Therapy serves families in the following Florida counties: St. Lucie, Martin, Indian River, Palm Beach, Hendry, Glades, Highlands and Okeechobee.

Cities with dedicated pages: Fort Pierce (office location), Port St. Lucie, Stuart, Vero Beach, West Palm Beach. See /service-areas for the full list, or /service-areas/[city-slug] for a specific city page.

Service availability varies by location, staffing, clinical need and insurance authorization.
